corner_radius = 2.82
hook_width = 9.3
hook_thickness = 1.3  # snap beam thickness (strength)
hook_setback = 0.37  # beam outer face inset from plate edge
lip_bottom_z = 16.01  # critical: catch face height
lip_height = 3.08
lip_reach = 1.19  # critical: lip tip beyond plate edge
tongue_length = 2.96
tongue_width = 11.43

    .extrude(plate_thickness)
    .edges("|Z").fillet(corner_radius)
)

beam_top = lip_bottom_z + lip_height
beam = cq.Workplane("XY").box(hook_thickness, hook_width, beam_top - plate_thickness + 0.5, centered=False).translate((beam_x - hook_thickness, -hook_width / 2, plate_thickness - 0.5))

lip = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .polyline([

        (tip_x, lip_bottom_z),
        (tip_x, lip_bottom_z + 0.35 * lip_height),
        (beam_x - 0.5, beam_top),

    .extrude(hook_width / 2, both=True)
)
tongue = cq.Workplane("XY").box(tongue_length + 1, tongue_width, tongue_thickness, centered=False).translate((-plate_length / 2 - tongue_length, -tongue_width / 2, plate_thickness - tongue_thickness))
